no frame: a list of a correlation matrix of eight physical measurements, its centres and n.obs; no observations
no frame: a list of a correlation matrix of 24 psychological tests, its centres and n.obs; no observations
no frame: a list of a covariance matrix of six ability tests, its centres and n.obs; no observations

Guber (1999) state SAT scores and school spending (spend, stu_tea_rat, salary, prcnt_take, sat_v, sat_m, sat_t), one row per US state without a state column; no notebook of the pinned tree reads it; no grouping factor.

NOAA HURDAT2: a storm header line (id, name, track count) above each storm's track lines of 21 fields, read as one table under the first header's 4 columns, so no table of the tracks loads; case_studies/ssm_hurricane_tracking parses it by hand for a state space model of single storm tracks.
The text file of the rosdata object hibbs (the same 16 elections), itself excluded as a time series without replication; read since the loader honours write.table's quotes (#14).

ROS HDI: human development index by US state (rank, state, hdi, canada.dist), one row per state; a cross-sectional example, no grouping factor; read since the loader honours write.table's quotes (#14).
